headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.retainedRank_at_positive
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs : List ℕ) (i : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PositiveRows (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs)),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.retainedRank xs ↑↑i = ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv xs).symm i)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginMatrix_code
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (X :
    OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys)),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginMatrix xs ys (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginListEquiv xs ys).symm X)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginMatrix_row_length
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (A : OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.MatrixCode) (i : Fin xs.length),
  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginMatrix xs ys A)[↑i].length = ys.length
